en.title: Halo Campaign Evolved: Master Chief's Best Weapons Revealed
en.summary: Master Chief's arsenal in Halo Campaign Evolved is vast, but some weapons stand head and shoulders above the rest. We break down the ultimate loadouts for slicing through the Banished and beyond.
en.body:
Master Chief's journey through the Zeta Halo in **Halo Campaign Evolved** offers a familiar yet expanded arsenal, demanding strategic choices against the relentless Banished. While the campaign can be cleared with a variety of armaments, focusing on the most potent weapons can dramatically improve your efficiency, especially when facing tougher combat encounters or exploring the open world.

Destructoid's analysis highlights a clear hierarchy among the available weaponry. At the pinnacle, the **S-tier** comprises weapons that are not only powerful but also remarkably user-friendly and versatile. The **Sentinel Beam** earns its spot with consistent accuracy, solid damage output, and the convenient ability to be scavenged from fallen Sentinel robots. Its sustained fire can melt through shields and armor with ease. Equally dominant is the **Energy Sword**, a close-quarters menace that transforms Master Chief into an unstoppable force, capable of slicing through multiple enemies in rapid succession. For those who prefer a more balanced approach, the **Assault Rifle** proves its worth. It strikes an excellent balance between firepower, rate of fire, and manageable recoil, making it a reliable choice for both seasoned veterans and newcomers to the Halo universe.

Moving down to the **A-tier**, these weapons offer strong performance but come with specific caveats that require a bit more player management. The **Rocket Launcher** is an obvious powerhouse, capable of clearing out groups of enemies or dealing significant damage to larger targets, but its limited ammunition means every shot must count. The **Beam Rifle**, a staple for long-range engagements, is placed here due to occasional reliability issues, though its potential for rapid, high-damage shots is undeniable when it performs optimally. For players who excel at precision and keeping their distance, the **Sniper Rifle** remains an exceptionally effective tool, capable of taking down high-value targets with single, well-placed shots.

## The Cost of Power: Managing Your Loadout

For dedicated players looking to truly master the campaign, understanding these tiers is key to building effective loadouts. The S-tier weapons offer a safety net, consistently performing well across a wide range of combat scenarios. However, the A-tier weapons, while requiring more tactical consideration, can be equally devastating. A well-timed rocket can turn the tide of a desperate battle, and a precise sniper shot can neutralize a dangerous threat before it even engages. The true challenge for many players lies in adapting their strategy based on the weapons available and the specific threats presented by the Banished and the environment.

## What's Next for Spartan Gear?

As players continue to explore the vast landscapes of Zeta Halo and delve into its secrets, the effectiveness of their chosen weapons will undoubtedly shape their experience. Future updates or downloadable content for **Halo Campaign Evolved** could introduce new armaments or modify existing ones, potentially shifting this established meta. For now, mastering the S and A-tier weapons provides the most direct path to Spartan supremacy.

content_raw: Halo Campaign Evolved offers many weapons to equip as Master Chief, and some of them are definitely better than the rest. In this guide, I will help you understand which weapons are strong to use and which ones are not that good in the first place. While you can use various of them to clear in-game content, focusing on the meta will make it easier for you, especially on the online side of things. Halo Campaign Evolved weapons tier list I have used three different tiers and tables to separate all the available weapons. S-tier weapons are the best choice you can have. They’re extremely overpowered, easy to use, and get the job done on all occasions. A-tier choices are decent alternatives to S-tier options. They are strong but have slight weaknesses that you will need to manage. B-tier choices are difficult to master, and they will require a lot of time and effort from you. Image via Xbox S-tier Name Reason Sentinel Beam A powerful weapon that’s accurate, does decent damage, and it’s easy to obtain from Sentinel Robots. Energy Sword No other weapon feels as powerful to use as the Energy Sword. Simply equip and slice through opponents like they are pieces of paper. Assault Rifle The Assault Rifle combines decent firepower, good fire rate, and recoil control, making it easy for beginners and veterans alike. A-tier Name Reason Rocket Launcher The Rocket Launcher is powerful. It has very limited ammo, and you need to know when to use it for best results. Beam Rifle The Beam Rifle sometimes misfires in my experience, which is the major reason why I put it on the A-tier. Otherwise, it’s a really solid pick. Sniper Rifle If you are someone who likes to play from a distance and is great with your aim, the Sniper Rifle is a very effective choice, especially in multiplayer. Fuel Rod Gun The Fuel Rod Gun is fun and has decent damage, but the ammo can be slightly iffy to manage. Spiker The Spiker is not exactly efficient, but I have a lot of fun with it, and the in-game effects are super amusing to look at. Brute Plasma Rifle Big guns do big damage, and the Brute Plasma Rifle is a great example of it. B-tier Weapon Reason Needle Rifle Not the strongest of weapons, the Needle Rifle is still a good backup to use. Plasma Rifle Despite having decent damage, the Plasma Rifle is definitely not as strong as the Assault Rifle. Needler A good secondary weapon that gets the job done. Battle Rifle An extremely efficient weapon but lacks in firepower Shotgun Getting too close to an enemy to make the weapon effective is not my cup of tea. If you like that kind of play style, the shotgun can be considered A-tier. Magnum The Magnum has decent damage, but it’s very difficult to work around with. There are two guns that are missing from the tier list: Plasma Pistol and Submachine Gun.
